items.title: Albert "Baby Brousse" Broussard Interview, 1961-02-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You talk about Big Bill's brother? Big Bill's brother. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, Carbone. We used to call him Kev. Frank Carbone. It was a nickname that we gave him. His name was Frank Thomas, see? But we called him Frank Carbone. Oh, yeah.
You talk about Big Bill's brother? Big Bill's brother.
